=== Drop before an item moves the subtree above it
--- given
- a
- b
  - b1
- c‸
--- when drop 1 before 0
--- then
- ‸b
  - b1
- a
- c

=== Drop after an item lands after its whole subtree
--- given
- a
- b
  - b1
- c
--- when drop 0 after 1
--- then
- b
  - b1
- ‸a
- c

=== Drop into a childless item makes the dragged item its first child
--- given
- a
- b
- c
--- when drop 2 child 0
--- then
- a
  - ‸c
- b

=== Drop into an item with children puts the dragged item first
--- given
- a
  - a1
- b
--- when drop 2 child 0
--- then
- a
  - ‸b
  - a1

=== Drop takes the indent step from the target's children
--- given
- a
    - a1
- b
--- when drop 2 child 0
--- then
- a
    - ‸b
    - a1

=== Drop before a nested item takes that item's indent
--- given
- a
  - a1
- b
--- when drop 2 before 1
--- then
- a
  - ‸b
  - a1

=== Drop inside its own subtree is refused
--- given
- a
  - a1
- b
--- when drop 0 child 1
--- then consumed
- a
  - a1
- b

=== Drop keeps the dragged item's fold and unfolds a folded target it enters
--- given
- a ⊟
  - a1
- b ⊟
  - b1
--- when drop 2 child 0
--- then
- a
  - ‸b ⊟
    - b1
  - a1

=== Drop renumbers an ordered list
--- given
1. a
2. b
3. c
--- when drop 2 before 0
--- then
1. ‸c
2. a
3. b

=== Drop carries the notes lines
--- given
- a
  a note
- b
--- when drop 0 after 2
--- then
- b
- ‸a
  a note

=== Drop from a notes line of the dragged item moves the owning item
--- given
- a
  a note
- b
--- when drop 1 after 2
--- then
- b
- ‸a
  a note

=== Drop on a line outside the list is refused
--- given
- a
- b
paragraph
--- when drop 0 after 2
--- then consumed
- a
- b
paragraph

=== Drop after the previous sibling changes nothing
--- given
- a
- b
--- when drop 1 after 0
--- then
- a
- ‸b

=== Drop writes fold markers when the file remembers folds
--- given markers=on
- a ⊟
  - a1
- b
--- when drop 2 child 0
--- then
- a
  - ‸b
  - a1
